turns.question: How many MQLs did paid social bring in during September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no MQL metric, so this is not answered directly; the closest metric is Leads (CRM leads created, counted on the day created), and paid social (the social channel) created 40 leads from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30. Freshness: Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
